verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among its general assistant features, so the product appears to ship its own scheduling capability. The evidence is only a single category heading with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: confirmation that schedules recur rather than run once, documentation of how scheduled jobs or workflows are configured and managed, scope of what agent tasks can be scheduled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
